question: As of 10 April 2022, who among the following has been the longest serving Prime Minister of India?
solution:
The correct answer is Jawaharlal Nehru.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's longest-serving prime minister was Jawaharlal Nehru.**
 
• Assuming office in **1947,** he served as I**ndia's first Prime Minister after independence.**
 
• Because of his support for the cause of children's education, **his birth date** is commemorated in India as **"Children's Day."**
 
• Children referred to him as **Chacha Nehru.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Facts about the Prime Minister of India:**

 
 

 **India's second-longest-serving prime minister**
 Indira Gandhi
 
 

 **First non-Congressman to serve as Prime Minister of India**
 Morarji Desai
 
 

 **India's youngest prime minister**
 Rajiv Gandhi
 
 

 **First Indian Prime Minister who served in the Rajya Sabha**
 Indira Gandhi
 
 

 **First South Indian Prime Minister**
 P.V. Narasimha
 
 

 **The Indian Prime Minister received Pakistan's highest civilian honor.**
 Morarji Desai
 
 

 **The first female Prime Minister to be awarded the Bharat Ratna.**
 Indira Gandhi
 
 

 **Twice serving as acting prime minister**
 Gulzari Lal Nanda
